owners: src/pinboard/mcp/consolidation_operations.py: consolidation preview/confirm request decoding and rejection projection
src/pinboard/mcp/initiative_operations.py: initiative and roadmap request decoding and rejection projection
identity.rationale: Retain the exact native pair. Consolidation decodes its PreviewRequest or ConfirmRequest and produces a consolidation DecisionFailureCode, recovery for separate human confirmation, and correct-input or refresh-action results. Initiative decodes its distinct read, roadmap and mutation leaves and produces an initiative RejectionCode and its own read/roadmap recovery with correct-input. The common decoding algorithm already belongs to msgspec.convert. A shared wrapper would need both schema and rejection behavior as parameters while obscuring the owning boundary. Reopen if a supported shared request family and matching recovery/retry contract replace these separate owners, or if one boundary loses its consumer.

owners: src/pinboard/mcp/contracts.py: action_invocation_tool selects supported MCP request destinations
src/pinboard/mcp/contracts.py: _committed_transition_surfaces validates committed result effect combinations
identity.rationale: Independent review: retain this exact detector pair. action_invocation_tool classifies supported MCP request destinations; _committed_transition_surfaces validates allowed committed-result effects. These are independent supported protocol decisions, not two copies of one classification. Concrete counterexamples: CLOSE and CANCEL both permit ledger-only committed effects, but CLOSE routes to pinboard_close while CANCEL has no starter. ACCEPT_CHECKPOINT and ACTIVATE both route to pinboard_transition but permit different committed surfaces. SUBMIT_REVIEW routes to transition and permits artifact effects, unlike the ledger-only PR actions in the second list. Sharing the matched list would couple request routing to effect validation or introduce an artificial common subset without a shared product decision. Existing exhaustive branches keep newly introduced action kinds visible at both independently relevant boundaries. No decoder relaxation, dispatch change, state mutation, or new generic routing table is justified. Reopen if a single accepted protocol owner genuinely determines both classifications or either branch loses its supported consumer. This certificate covers only the present native pair and source bytes; it is not candidate acceptance or a blanket future exemption. No tests were run for this read-only semantic assessment.

owners: src/pinboard/mcp/contracts.py: PreparationAuthorityCommitted defines the preparation result and its exact wire order
src/pinboard/mcp/contracts.py: AttemptAuthorityCommitted defines the attempt result and its exact wire order
identity.rationale: Retain the exact native pair. Preparation receipts have an item, definition revision and digest, and a preparation lease status. Attempt receipts have an attempt, its item, and an attempt lease status. Both negotiated records require their own flat layouts with identity fields before the common receipt fields, and the typed emitter preserves declaration order in the result bytes. A common Struct field base would prepend the shared receipt fields or require a separate order conversion. The commitment and warning invariant is now shared by both constructors and transition results via _require_fixed_state_changed and _require_committed_warning. The remaining constructor hooks only invoke those owners. Reopen if a supported common flat record preserves both schemas and emitted bytes without a second layout projection, or if the two constructors begin independently rebuilding a common invariant.

owners: src/pinboard/mcp/mutation_operations.py: _preparation_authority selects the item-keyed revoke and observes preparation authority on rejection
src/pinboard/mcp/mutation_operations.py: _attempt_authority selects the attempt-keyed revoke and observes attempt authority on rejection
identity.rationale: Retain the exact native pair. Revocation uses distinct closed request families, identifier types, application transactions and status queries. Preparation can be unavailable without a preparation snapshot and uses item status recovery. Attempt revocation fences against the attempt lease and uses attempt inspection recovery. The shared rejection message and observation conversions already have their own helpers. Sharing this exhaustive arm would introduce a callback or generic subject merely to repeat the two direct calls and would obscure where each failure is observed. Reopen if one supported revocation command and one authority/status transaction own both families, or if a new consumer needs a shared decision that both arms independently reconstruct.
